data.narrative:
Skild AI, a Series C AI & Software company founded by Deepak Pathak and Abhinav Gupta, carries a current post-money valuation of $14.0B following $1.4B+ in total capital raised. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 9 comparable companies across AI & Software—1 public (Palantir) and 8 private including Figure AI, Crusoe Energy, Together AI, and Scale AI.

Two valuation methods are applicable and triangulated. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C-to-next-stage progression to the $14.0B base, yielding $23.8B. Peer-median analysis references three same-sector, same-stage comparables—Figure AI ($39.0B), Crusoe Energy ($10.0B), and Together AI ($8.3B)—producing a median of $10.0B. The peer range spans $8.3B to $39.0B, reflecting material dispersion in the AI & Software space at this stage.

The triangulated analysis implies a valuation range of $8.5B (floor) to $27.4B (ceiling), with a median of $16.9B. The current $14.0B valuation sits within this range but toward the lower bound, reflecting material uncertainty around whether Skild AI will command a premium or median multiple relative to its peer set. Key uncertainties include relative product-market fit, revenue traction, and near-term financing dynamics that could shift stage-progression timing.
